# Quantifying the Improvement of Gated Recurrent Neural Tensor Networks over Gated RNN Baselines

## Introduction

The paper "Gated Recurrent Neural Tensor Network" introduces two hybrid recurrent architectures that fuse the gating mechanism of gated recurrent networks with the tensor-product hidden-state interaction previously exploited in recursive neural tensor networks (Tjandra et al., 2017). The two proposed models are the Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Tensor Network (LSTMRNTN) and the Gated Recurrent Unit Recurrent Neural Tensor Network (GRURNTN).
